verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਘੁਣ ਖਾਧੀ ਲਕੜੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਤਾਣਿ ਨਿਤਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau ghun khaadhee lakaRee vin taan nitaanee|

en.bdb: He (the apostate) becomes feeble and powerless as the weevil-eaten wood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੁ ਡਰਾਵਾ ਖੇਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jaan ddaraavaa khet vich nirajeeau paraanee|

en.bdb: He is similar to the life-less scarecrow put up in the field to frighten (the birds).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਧੂਅਰੁ ਝੜੁਵਾਲ ਦੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਰਸੈ ਪਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau dhooar jhaRuvaal dhee kiau varasai paanee|

en.bdb: How out of clouds of smoke rain could take place.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਥਣ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਕਰੀ ਦੁਹਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਨਾ ਆਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau than gal vich bakaree dhuh dhudh naa aanee|

en.bdb: As the teat of a goat in the neck cannot give milk, likewise the grabber of religious earning of a religious place roams hither and thither in the craving of the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਝਾਕੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਝਾਕਵਾਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jhaake a(n)dhar jhaakavaal tis kiaa neesaanee|

en.bdb: What is the exact mark of such a man.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚਮੁਚਟੈ ਗਾਇ ਮਹਿ ਉਹ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit_en: jiau chamuchaTai gai meh uh bharam bhulaanee ||16||

en.bdb: Such a man remains deluded like that cow who considering its dead offspiring alive goes on licking it
